newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 9.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 9.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Hungary's potato surplus of up to 300,000 tonnes has almost dwindled and the markets may even face a shortage.
- Interior Minister Gabor Kuncze told a news conference that he expected to announce soon new achievements in fight against organised crime.
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn told conference about the development of small and medium-size enterprises that Hungary was on the way to become the financial centre of central and eastern Europe.
- Opposition parties decided to work out a joint agricultural programme.
